description: Deprecated: use `cancel_hire` with the hire’s `escrowId`. End one hire on your bounty. If you would get back less than the full amount, the first call ends nothing and returns `status` of `confirmation_required`, your refund `totalRefundAmount` (cents), a `confirmationToken` and `expiresAt`. Show the user the refund amount. If they agree, call again with the same IDs and the `confirmationToken` before `expiresAt` to end the hire; the reply has `status` of `cancelled`. Repeating the confirmation is safe. If an error asks you to request cancellation again, call again without the token and show the new refund. A full refund ends the hire on the first call. Use `open_dispute` for problems with the work.

applicationId.description: The application ID of the hire to end

confirmationToken.description: The `confirmationToken` returned with `status` of `confirmation_required`. Send it before `expiresAt` to end the hire with the refund shown in that preview.
confirmationToken.title: minLength(1)

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason shown to the released worker (e.g. why the seat was reclaimed). Defaults to a generic no-activity explanation.
